items.title: Loren Schoenberg interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 14, 2019
items.q: He wanted Bob Haggart on bass. So we put Bob Haggart and Louie Bellson in the band

ctx.x: Later on, as the band got professional and as I started to make a living in music, all those guys, I mean I paid. I paid for arrangements. I paid arrangers and I paid — but at this time there was nothing there. So John Hammond and a few other things and things started, and next thing you know we’re going to make a record. So we made a record for a guy named Jerry Valburn who issued a lot of radio broadcasts with like a big jazz collector who had his own little labels. And he had a label and he started recording…

he had a Mercedes. So on some weekends I would actually drive Benny up with Carol to their house, like the chauffeur, drive them up to Stamford, leave them, then I would drive his car back and park it in his garage. And I mean I had never driven a Mercedes Benz but that’s another story. Drive it back, park it in his garage, and somehow they would get back on Sunday.
